texts.en: There is something unusual about this moon.

texts.zh:
对[From.GetName]的外壳深度扫描确认了我们的猜想，[From.GetName]不是一颗普通的月亮，整个星体都是人造结构，由矿藏丰富的岩石作为原材料建造而成，被一个巨大的钢铁框架结构包裹着。

看起来它被创造出来以降低[artificial_moon_planet.GetName]的自转速度，让其白天更长，潮汐更高，使其更加宜居。但目前我们可以确认没有任何生物曾在其上殖民过。
texts.en:
Deeper scans of [From.GetName]'s crust confirm what the crew already suspected - [From.GetName] is no ordinary moon. The entire planetary body is an artificial construct, made out of exceptionally mineral rich rock, packed around a massive steel framework.

Likely it was created to slow the rotational speed of [artificial_moon_planet.GetName], making the days longer and tides higher, priming it for habitation. As far as we can tell nobody ever settled the planet.

summary.text:
# 奇特卫星 / Unusual Moon

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration · DLC：《遥远繁星》Distant Stars（has_distar） · 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-12（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：common/anomalies/95_anomaly_categories_distant_stars.txt:1424-1455; events/distant_stars_events_2.txt:3689 (distar.2025)

## 如何开始 How it starts

需要《遥远繁星》。宜居星球的不宜居卫星（无站点矿藏）可能生成（3级，权重3，全局一次）。

Requires Distant Stars. Can spawn on an uninhabitable moon (no station deposits) of a habitable planet (level 3, weight 3, once per game).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

distar.2025“人工卫星”：整颗卫星是包裹着巨大钢架的人造天体，用来减慢母星自转、延长白昼、抬高潮汐，为居住做准备，但从未有人定居。卫星获得矿物矿藏。

distar.2025 "Artificial Moon": the whole moon is an artificial body of mineral-rich rock around a steel frame, built to slow its planet's rotation, lengthen days and raise tides for habitation; nobody ever settled there. The moon gains a minerals deposit.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

唯一结果。

Single outcome.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

无。

None.
